summary: This 8-K reports the closing of a previously announced merger where RYVYL Inc.'s wholly owned subsidiary merged with RTB Digital, Inc., with RTB surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary. The registrant changed its name to RTB Digital, Inc. in connection with the business combination. Ryvyl issued 11,893,886 shares for RTB's equity and assumed notes; no price per share or premium is stated. The post-merger company will trade under symbol RTB. This filing is a routine closing update on a completed merger with a name change, not a new special situation event—the merger agreement was entered in September 2025. No tender offer, activist campaign, or strategic review is initiated here. The event is a finalized transaction; therefore, no special situation classification is applicable.
